cd /app && python3 - <<'PY'
from PIL import Image
from collections import Counter
im=Image.open('chess_board.png').convert('RGB')
print(Counter(im.getdata()).most_common(15))
# print each square 20x20 by sampling center of 4x4 and mark pixels differing strongly from corner background
for r in range(8):
 for c in range(8):
  sq=[]
  bg=im.getpixel((c*80+2,r*80+2)); bg2=im.getpixel((c*80+78,r*80+78))
  # classify sampled blocks: foreground if not close to either board color, but pieces may white
  for yy in range(4,76,4):
   line=''
   for xx in range(4,76,4):
    p=im.getpixel((c*80+xx,r*80+yy))
    # board colors estimated from corners; foreground based distance to both
    d=min(sum((p[i]-bg[i])**2 for i in range(3)),sum((p[i]-bg2[i])**2 for i in range(3)))
    line += '#' if d>500 else ' '
   sq.append(line)
  if any('#' in x for x in sq):
   print(f'{chr(97+c)}{8-r} bg={bg}:')
   print('\n'.join(sq))
PY
